title: Probability of a subset of a finite set
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $T$ be a subset of $J$. Under the Shapley subset distribution on subsets of $J$, the probability of selecting $T$ is $1/((|J|+1)\binom{|J|}{|T|})$.
